title: Instructional Designer
description:
ADP is hiring a Learning Design Consultant (Instructional Designer).


In this role, you will focus primarily on applying efficient and agile design approaches to develop innovative, engaging learning solutions, using ADP learning design standards and tools, to meet the learning needs of ADP associates and clients.


No two days are the same. You will do everything from creating design documents, testing and deploying content, conducting needs assessments across multiple business lines, establishing training plans, overseeing translations, measuring results, and more. You will do this all to the highest standards with an eye on appealing to multi-generational talent and the modern learner and by partnering across the learning organization to apply innovative techniques in instructional design. You can create compelling content and convey ideas and information to many levels of an organization.


To thrive in the role, you have 3+ years of experience in the learning - development field. You have worked independently to design and develop sound training in various modalities, i.e., eLearning, instructor-led, blended, job aids, and more, and can manage simultaneous projects with deadlines. It would be best to be a continuous learner who focuses on personal development and business process improvement to our design standards. Your work will help our businesses support our clients who employ one to millions of employees.


Like what you see? Apply now!


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Innovation : You seek opportunities to apply innovative design thinking to your projects and will work to keep ADP's approach to designing learning up to date with the products and solutions ADP offers its clients.
  • Flexibility and Agility : You can adapt to changing business requirements, projects, and resources and use agile approaches to meet business needs.
  • Design: You'll design holistic solutions engaging team members and business partners in the design process to ensure the solution design is flexible and addresses the unique needs of the learners. Solution design should consider and factor in how the work environment impacts learning.
  • Development: You can develop solutions across a broad set of learning modalities and tools without creating redundant solutions and ensure that continuous learning and performance support concepts are applied.
  • Learning Outcomes: You measure your outcomes and ensure your learning solutions result in the intended business impact.
  • Continuous Learner: You focus on personal development to develop and elevate professional knowledge and skill. You take the same approach to business process improvement to improve ADP learning design standards and drive the adoption of those standards. You maintain an outside-in perspective by building and maintaining peer networks inside and outside ADP.


TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

A college degree is not required but could set you apart. What's more important is having the skills and experience to do the job. You will need 3+ years of experience in instructional development, adult learning theory, and/or technical writing.

Other things that will set you apart:

  • Experience using eLearning tools such as Captivate, Articulate 360 , Synthesia, TechSmith Camtasia , TechSmith SnagIt, Audacity, and Vyond. Technical aptitude to quickly learn new development tools.
  • Experience using a Learning Management System (i.e., Litmos)
  • Experience with simple Graphic Design


Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in the learning and development field
  • Ability to systematically design, develop, and implement learning content that meets specific organizational needs
  • Skilled in building learning solutions for English-speaking audiences
  • Proficient in Articulate Storyline, Rise, Synthesia, or similar authoring tools
  • Working knowledge of Learning Management Systems (upload/manage content, apply technical standards, etc.)
  • Proven success collaborating virtually


YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Collaborate. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and respect one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner - doer. Mission-driven and committed to navigating change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.


Learn more here:

What are you waiting for? Apply now!

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.

Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Marketing Coordinator to join our growing team!


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!


About You


  • Highly motivated and passionate about delivering excellent work
  • Proactive, always anticipating potential challenges and crafting solutions
  • Strong communicator, ensuring clarity with both internal teams and clients
  • Professional level of English (written and spoken)
  • Friendly, respectful, and able to work effectively within a team
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and resourceful—you find answers when needed and make sure things are running smoothly
  • You’re a people person and love finding ways to solve problems with creative ideas
  • Excellent time management and ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
  • You love talking through ideas, offering feedback, and helping teams align with client goals
  • A background in marketing is essential
  • Nerdiness is a bonus! If you love D&D, Pokémon, video games, or books, we’ll get along just fine!

title: Junior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Python Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Create data integration services to help onboard new customers as quickly as possible.

- Maintain ongoing reliability, performance, and support of the data infrastructure, providing solutions based on application needs and anticipated growth.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of practical experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience in development with object-oriented programming is desirable.

- 1 year of development using other programming languages.

- Good skills with XML and relational databases (Oracle / MS SQL / MySQL).

- Strong professional experience working with large data structures (including XML) and algorithms.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Search Engine Marketing Strategist
description:
Estratégista de Marketing de Busca (Search Engine Marketing Strategist) WPP Media Studio – Divisão de E-Commerce

Meio período · Trabalho remoto

Uma Marca Fundada em Inovação, Confiança e Crescimento Sustentável

Na WPP Media Studio , acreditamos no poder do marketing digital para gerar conexões reais e duradouras. Nosso compromisso com a excelência e inovação nos permite ajudar marcas globais a alcançar seus objetivos, maximizando o impacto e a relevância no mundo digital.

Com uma visão focada em estratégias de longo prazo e baseadas em dados, somos movidos pelo propósito de oferecer soluções eficazes e resultados consistentes. Nossa missão é criar experiências digitais que transformam marcas e conectam empresas com seus consumidores de maneira significativa.

Agora, para fortalecer nossa equipe de marketing digital, estamos em busca de um Estratégista de Marketing de Busca (SEM) altamente qualificado. Se você é uma pessoa apaixonada por resultados, com uma visão estratégica e foco em performance, queremos que você se junte a nós para construir o futuro do marketing de busca e e-commerce.

Por que esta função é importante?

O marketing de busca é uma das pedras angulares das estratégias de marketing digital, especialmente no e-commerce. Como Estratégista de Marketing de Busca , você será responsável por desenvolver e implementar estratégias de SEM (Search Engine Marketing) que impulsionam o tráfego, aumentam a visibilidade da marca e, acima de tudo, geram conversões para nossos clientes.

Esta função é essencial porque:

  • Impulsiona a visibilidade digital e o tráfego qualificado para as marcas com as quais trabalhamos
  • Maximiza o ROI (Retorno sobre o Investimento) de campanhas de mídia paga através de otimizações contínuas
  • Gerencia e executa campanhas de Google Ads, Bing Ads e outras plataformas de busca , garantindo máxima eficiência
  • Contribui diretamente para a estratégia de e-commerce , gerando resultados tangíveis e mensuráveis

Seu trabalho terá um impacto direto no crescimento e no sucesso contínuo de nossos clientes no universo digital.

Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento e Execução de Estratégias SEM

  • Criar estratégias eficazes para campanhas de Google Ads , Bing Ads e outras plataformas de busca
  • Gerenciar a execução e otimização de campanhas de SEM, focando em aquisição de tráfego e conversões
  • Realizar pesquisa de palavras-chave , análise da concorrência e monitoramento de tendências de mercado

Otimização de Desempenho

  • Monitorar e otimizar continuamente campanhas com o objetivo de melhorar o CPC (Custo por Clique) , CTR (Taxa de Clique) e ROI (Retorno sobre o Investimento)
  • Utilizar dados de Google Analytics e outras ferramentas analíticas para avaliar o desempenho das campanhas
  • Conduzir testes A/B para aprimorar a performance das campanhas e o conteúdo dos anúncios

Análise e Relatórios

  • Preparar relatórios detalhados sobre o desempenho das campanhas e fornecer insights acionáveis aos clientes
  • Traduzir dados e métricas de desempenho em recomendações claras para ajustes nas campanhas
  • Monitorar a configuração de pixels de rastreamento , ações de conversão e outras métricas relevantes

Colaboração e Comunicação

  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com as equipes de criatividade , conteúdo e e-commerce para garantir a consistência da marca e a eficácia das campanhas
  • Manter uma comunicação aberta com os clientes, fornecendo atualizações regulares sobre o progresso das campanhas
Qualificações Necessárias
  • Experiência comprovada em marketing de busca com foco em Google Ads e Bing Ads
  • Sólido conhecimento de SEO (Search Engine Optimization) e SEM (Search Engine Marketing)
  • Experiência com Google Analytics e outras ferramentas de monitoramento de desempenho
  • Habilidade para interpretar dados e fazer ajustes para melhorar resultados de campanhas
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas campanhas simultaneamente com um alto nível de precisão e atenção aos detalhes
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação e relacionamento com clientes
  • Trabalho remoto com autonomia e alta responsabilidade
Experiência Preferencial

(Não obrigatória, mas será um diferencial)

  • Experiência com plataformas de publicidade programática e remarketing
  • Certificações avançadas em Google Ads e Microsoft Advertising
  • Conhecimento de otimização da taxa de conversão (CRO) e criação de páginas de destino eficazes
  • Experiência no mercado de e-commerce e em campanhas digitais que geram receita
Benefícios e Cultura de Trabalho

Na WPP Media Studio , nossa cultura se baseia na confiança, transparência e no trabalho em equipe. Acreditamos que nossos colaboradores devem ter o espaço e a flexibilidade para prosperar. Oferecemos:

  • Trabalho remoto flexível : você poderá trabalhar de qualquer lugar, com horários flexíveis
  • Crescimento profissional contínuo : oportunidades para aprimorar suas habilidades e influenciar a estratégia de marketing digital
  • Ambiente colaborativo : uma equipe dinâmica e engajada que trabalha com sinergia para alcançar os melhores resultados
  • Foco no impacto : trabalhamos para gerar valor real para nossos clientes e construir parcerias de longo prazo
  • Cultura missionária : nosso compromisso é sempre com a qualidade, inovação e resultados sustentáveis
  • Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, o desenvolvimento contínuo e o impacto real que nossos colaboradores fazem na transformação digital de nossos clientes.

title: Customer Service Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Customer Service Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $840-$$1,400 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,680-$2,800 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10,5 - $17,5 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary :


The Customer Service Specialist will be responsible for providing exceptional customer support, resolving inquiries and complaints, managing customer accounts, and ensuring a positive customer experience across all communication channels.


Job Tasks :


  • Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and social media in a timely and professional manner.
  • Problem Resolution: Identify customer issues, troubleshoot problems, and provide effective solutions or escalate when necessary.

title: Senior Clinical Data Science Programmer
description:
Senior Clinical Data Science Programmer - Remote - Brazil


ICON plc is a world-leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development


We are currently seeking a Senior Clinical Data Science Programmer to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Senior Clinical Data Science Programmer at ICON, you will play a pivotal role in developing and implementing programming solutions to support the analysis and reporting of clinical trial data. You will contribute to the advancement of innovative treatments and therapies by ensuring the accuracy and efficiency of data processing through your programming expertise.


What You Will Be Doing:

  • Develop, validate, and maintain programming solutions for CDMS (EDC systems such as Rave/Veeva), data validation outputs, data review/risk management outputs, custom reports, and programs in clinical trials.
  • Collaborate with data managers, project managers, clinical data scientists, and biostatisticians to ensure the integration of programming solutions into the overall data management process.
  • Act as a primary point of contact during the study set up and maintenance phase for system programming related questions by the project team.
  • Support colleagues with the clinical trials environment and concepts of Clinical Data Management Systems.
  • Perform extracts of data from CDMS and creation of data

title: Change Management Leader
description:
Vaga: Líder de Treinamento LATAM


Local: São Paulo, 2x presencial e com possibilidade de viagens pela América Latina


Empresa: A Inetum é uma empresa líder global em serviços de TI, dedicada a fornecer soluções inovadoras aos nossos clientes. Estamos comprometidos em promover um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, inclusivo e que preza pela diversidade, onde a criatividade e a colaboração prosperem. Estamos presentes em 19 países e somos mais de 28.000 colaboradores no mundo.

Se você está em busca de uma empresa dinâmica, inovadora e tecnológica , a Inetum é o seu lugar! Vem ser Inetum !


Projeto: Salesforce Broker Cloud


Visão Geral


Estamos em busca de um(a) Líder de Treinamento LATAM para atuar no desenvolvimento e execução de conteúdos de capacitação em português para o projeto Salesforce Broker Cloud. Essa posição será responsável por criar um plano de treinamento local alinhado à estratégia global, desenvolver materiais, conduzir sessões de capacitação de multiplicadores e colaborar diretamente com o líder global sediado nos EUA.


Principais Responsabilidades


1. Desenvolvimento do Plano de Treinamento Localizado

  • Criar plano de treinamento adaptado às necessidades dos usuários LATAM
  • Desenvolver conteúdos para até cinco perfis de usuários
  • Avaliar necessidades de capacitação e alinhar com o líder global


2. Criação e Revisão de Conteúdo de Treinamento

  • Produzir e revisar materiais em português para a equipe do cliente
  • Utilizar ferramentas definidas pelo cliente (ex.: WalkMe, Captivate, Camtasia)
  • Garantir que o conteúdo seja envolvente, eficaz e alinhado às atividades no Salesforce
